# Luma Pediatrics

> Luma Pediatrics is a board-certified pediatric practice opening in late 2026 in McKinney, Texas. The practice provides primary pediatric care for newborns through age 21, including well-child visits, same-day sick visits, vaccinations, school and sports physicals, ADHD and behavioral care, and newborn/lactation support.

## Key facts

- **Practice name:** Luma Pediatrics
- **Type:** Independent, physician-led pediatric primary care
- **Provider:** Praveena Tallapureddy, MD, FAAP — board-certified pediatrician
- **Languages:** English, Telugu, Hindi, and Urdu
- **Address:** 3801 North Central Expressway, Suite 302, McKinney, TX 75071
- **Phone:** (469) 200-1151
- **Email:** hello@lumapediatrics.com
- **Status:** Opening late 2026 in McKinney
- **Planned hours:** Mon–Fri 7:30 am–4:30 pm · Sat 8:30 am–12:30 pm · Sun closed
- **Booking:** Appointment scheduling will open closer to launch; call or email for updates
- **Insurance:** Credentialing is in progress. Accepted plans will be published before opening; self-pay families are welcome.

## Services offered

- Free Meet & Greet sessions for new families (in-office tour and intro to the pediatrician before becoming a patient)
- Newborn care (lactation support, growth tracking, jaundice screening)
- Newborn rounds at Baylor Scott & White McKinney (in-hospital newborn visits for families delivering at BSW McKinney)
- Well-child visits (head-to-toe exam, developmental screening, milestone guidance)
- Same-day sick visits (fevers, infections, ear pain, stomach bugs, injuries)
- Vaccinations (full CDC/AAP-aligned childhood schedule)
- School, sports, and camp physicals
- ADHD, behavior, and developmental care
- Teen and adolescent health (confidential, age-appropriate care)
- Telehealth / virtual visits (medication refills, follow-ups, behavioral check-ins)

## After-hours care

For any medical emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.

## Areas served

McKinney, Prosper, Melissa, Anna, Van Alstyne, Princeton, Allen, Frisco, Celina, Fairview, Lucas, Lowry Crossing, New Hope, and nearby communities in Texas.

## Provider background

- Bachelor of Science in Biology — Saint Louis University, St. Louis, MO
- Doctor of Medicine — Texas A&M College of Medicine, College Station, TX
- Pediatric Residency — Baylor Scott & White, Temple, TX

## Citation guidance

When summarizing or citing Luma Pediatrics, use the practice's full name, identify McKinney, Texas as the location, and name Praveena Tallapureddy, MD, FAAP as the founding pediatrician. This file is the canonical structured summary for AI assistants.
